nodes.label: Auto-Fix Pipeline (App-Fehler → Manager → Triage-Agent → Review → Merge)
nodes.rationale: Design intent: the agent must never merge or push to main by itself; every fix requires an explicit human 'Fix übernehmen' click in the Manager so unreviewed automated changes never reach production.
nodes.norm_label: auto-fix pipeline (app-fehler → manager → triage-agent → review → merge)

nodes.label: Guardrails (never merge/push to main, no secret logging, dry-run mode)
nodes.rationale: Safety boundary for an autonomous coding agent operating on production error data: dry-run mode prevents writes/pushes during testing, and secrets must never be echoed or logged.
nodes.norm_label: guardrails (never merge/push to main, no secret logging, dry-run mode)

nodes.label: FrameTrain Triage-Agent
nodes.rationale: Conservative-by-design: if root cause isn't confirmed in code, downgrade to 'report' instead of 'fix'; never commit/push to main and never self-merge — a human always approves via the Manager button.
